name: Sins of the Everlasting Twilight
source:
You live a peaceful life in a beautiful town lit by a neverending sunset. But you can’t help but question the world you live in. “There are too many things that don’t make sense in this world.”

One day, for some reason, you find yourself inside the forbidden clocktower that stands in the middle of the town. Inside, you meet an enigmatic young man who claims to be an “observer.” He claims that this world has been twisted by evil and entrusts you with a key that will supposedly help you return it to its true state.

Guided by the mysterious key, you unwillingly release three dashing Demons. Are they truly the sinful beings that everyone says they are? What secrets do their titles hold? Will the key be the secret to not only letting them free, but also unlocking their hearts?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.eveningcurse]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你在一座美麗的小鎮中平靜地生活，永不落幕的夕陽始終照耀著這裡。然而，你忍不住懷疑自己所處的世界。「這個世界裡，不合理的事情太多了。」

某天，不知為何，你進入了小鎮中央那座禁止入內的鐘樓。在裡面，你遇見一名自稱「觀察者」的神秘青年。他聲稱這個世界已被邪惡扭曲，並將一把鑰匙託付給你，據說它能幫助你讓世界恢復原貌。

在神秘鑰匙的指引下，你無意間釋放了三個俊美的惡魔。他們真的像眾人所說，是罪孽深重的存在嗎？他們的稱號中藏著什麼秘密？這把鑰匙能否在釋放他們的同時，也開啟他們的心扉？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.eveningcurse]Google Play[/url]］
